title: DISNEY ON BROADWAY Concert Series Dining Package | Walt Disney World Resort
body_text: DISNEY ON BROADWAY Concert Series Dining PackagesSavor a delicious meal and secure a guaranteed seat to a DISNEY ON BROADWAY concert during EPCOT International Festival of the Arts. The 2026 festival has concluded. Please check back later this year for information on the 2027 event.Show Tunes & Tasty EatsChoose from a variety of EPCOT eateries offering DISNEY ON BROADWAY Dining Packages. The dining package includes:A mouthwatering meal at an EPCOT restaurantA guaranteed seat at one of the DISNEY ON BROADWAY performances that same dayMore Seasonal Celebrations at EPCOTGarden Rocks Dining PackagesEnjoy a perfect pairing of flavor and fun during EPCOT International Flower & Garden Festival.Concert Series Dining PackagesRock out to renowned bands and delight in tasty eats at EPCOT International Food & Wine Festival.Candlelight Processional Dining PackagesCelebrate the season with a delicious tradition at EPCOT International Festival of the Holidays.
